rules: Verse order preserved in every excerpt
No new editorial biblical prose as substitute for exact Scripture
Omissions shown in reader; never join discontiguous Scripture as one unbroken quote
All ten Commandments, Beatitudes and the Lord's Prayer are complete
Book-chapter-verse edition concordance requires witness verification before final approval
A partial-verse citation such as Exodus 3:8a is not treated as a certified whole verse
No automatic source selection based on citation frequency

decisions.scene: Jacob wrestles and receives his name Israel

Historical source edition is probable, not certified.
